title: Cheaper Portable Crafting Table recipe
description: Make the Portable Crafting Table recipe cheaper.
body:
Make the Portable Crafting Table cheaper to make. It requires one stick and one crafting table in a shapeless recipe. The original recipe meant that you need two table one to use in crafting and one to craft the item.
All UIs are from JEI

Original Recipe
![Original Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c381f698f115567a7b855639deb6d9769c901637.png)

Current Recipe
![Current Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8f5d68a8a6cf805ee9e387b4d00891243cefc7a.png)

The current recipe is viable in the 2X2 crafting grid.

Do what you want with it except claim as yours and reupload.
